type: Surface-material PBR reuse on authored real 3D geometry

sources.asset: Granite Tile 04, one grout-free face crop

processing: No photograph, AI scene replacement, depth plate or projective texture is used.
Timber normal map supplies fine grain; a remapped 0.68–0.98 scanned roughness variation keeps paint weathered instead of mirror-like. Timber diffuse is sampled only on unpainted dark boards.
Carpentry UVs run in object-length metres and column circumference/height; actual instance scale can vary the final grain size.
Granite maps repeat as independent surface textures on closed authored rocks and lantern carvings; their scale is an artistic material fit, not a recovered geological measurement.
